Class 12 Physics · Ray Optics (convex mirrors, the mirror formula)
Physics, visualised #9

A car's wing mirror is a convex mirror. The image sits behind the glass, upright, and always smaller than the car, however close it comes (1/v + 1/u = 1/f).
The graph and the "what you see" panel compare it with a flat mirror, from the driver's seat.
Convex glass also shows a much wider view of the road.
Asked in JEE Main, NEET and MHT-CET: convex mirrors and magnification.
